blocks.text: Have you ever wondered why industries are located in certain areas and not others? Let's explore the factors influencing industrial locations and strategies for industrial growth in Nigeria.

blocks.markdown: Industrialisation is a crucial component of economic development in Nigeria. It involves the transformation of raw materials into finished goods and services. This process is vital for creating jobs, increasing GDP, and improving the standard of living.

blocks.title: Types of Industry
blocks.text: Industries are classified into three main types: extractive, manufacturing, and constructive. Extractive industries involve the extraction of raw materials, manufacturing industries process these materials, and constructive industries focus on building infrastructure.

blocks.markdown: The location of an industry is influenced by several factors, including availability of raw materials, access to markets, transportation facilities, power supply, and government policies. These factors determine the operational efficiency and profitability of industries.

blocks.title: Example: Locating a Cement Factory
blocks.prompt: Consider the factors influencing the location of a cement factory.

steps.text: Identify the raw materials required, such as limestone and gypsum.
Assess the proximity to markets where the cement will be sold.
Evaluate transportation facilities for moving raw materials and finished products.
Consider the availability of power supply to run machinery.

blocks.answer: A cement factory is ideally located near limestone deposits, with good transportation links and access to power, ensuring efficient production and distribution.

blocks.markdown: Nigeria adopts various strategies to boost industrialisation, including import substitution and export promotion. Import substitution aims to reduce dependency on imported goods by producing them locally, while export promotion focuses on increasing the production of goods for export to earn foreign exchange.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: When discussing industrial strategies, clearly differentiate between import substitution and export promotion. Use examples to illustrate how each strategy can benefit the Nigerian economy.

points: Industries are classified as extractive, manufacturing, or constructive.
Factors influencing industrial location include raw materials, market access, and power supply.
Import substitution and export promotion are key strategies for industrial growth in Nigeria.
